label_note: Primary E uses the strength percentile among ALL snapshot nodes (background legacy concepts + pool); pool concepts sit in the bottom ~5% so a 20-point gain is rare -> primary results are an UNDERPOWERED PILOT. E_alt (pre-declared sensitivity: percentile among pool+reference nodes only) is reported as the secondary label; it was promoted to a full analysis AFTER seeing primary n_emerging, which is disclosed here.

d4_substrate.note: percentile ranks of pool concepts are monotone in their (substrate-independent) strength within a year, so level Spearman is trivially ~1; the informative checks are the percentile GAINS across years and the overlap of top-20 association-strength neighbours
